title: GreyNoise reports active intrusion campaign against Check Point management servers
summary: GreyNoise reports an active intrusion campaign against Check Point security management servers, with attackers targeting the HFS loginSrp1 endpoint to obtain signed session cookies. Each login returned a new "sid" generated with JavaScript&\#x27;s Math.random\(\); by collecting several, the actor reconstructed the Node.js V8 PRNG state, recovered an HFS session-cookie signing key, and forged an admin session cookie. The account leaves the initial-access step unresolved; a commenter suggests CVE-2026-16232 as the likely vector and asks whether affected organizations exposed their management servers to the internet.
